summary: Coding agents, policy engines and repository controls provide complementary rails: operating-system containment, deterministic action policy and independent merge or deployment gates.

items.text: OpenAI Codex sandboxing: filesystem and network policies bound what agent-run commands can access independently of prompt compliance.
Claude Code sandboxing: operating-system primitives restrict filesystem and network access while preserving autonomous command execution inside the boundary.
GitHub protected branches: required reviews, status checks and merge restrictions create platform-owned gates after autonomous work.
Open Policy Agent: policy-as-code can evaluate structured action or deployment requests outside the agent process.
